question: 查询上周每天的订单数量和总销售额
sql: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 week' AND created_at < DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE) AND status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY order_date

question: 计算本月的复购率（下单超过1次的客户占比）
sql: WITH user_orders AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY user_id) SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count > 1)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS repurchase_rate_pct FROM user_orders

question: 查询上月复购超过3次的客户名单及其平均客单价
sql: WITH repeat_customers AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND created_at < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3) SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, rc.order_count, ROUND(rc.avg_order_value, 2) AS avg_order_value FROM repeat_customers rc JOIN users u ON u.id = rc.user_id ORDER BY rc.order_count DESC

question: 各广告平台的总花费和ROI（按订单金额/广告花费）
sql: WITH spend AS (SELECT ac.platform, SUM(as2.amount) AS total_spend FROM ad_spend as2 JOIN ad_campaigns ac ON ac.id = as2.campaign_id GROUP BY ac.platform), revenue AS (SELECT u.channel AS platform, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY u.channel) SELECT s.platform, s.total_spend, COALESCE(r.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, ROUND(COALESCE(r.total_revenue, 0) / NULLIF(s.total_spend, 0), 2) AS roi FROM spend s LEFT JOIN revenue r ON r.platform = s.platform ORDER BY roi DESC NULLS LAST

question: 按品类统计销售额Top5
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5

question: 计算各地区的订单中位数金额
sql: SELECT u.region, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.total_amount) AS median_order_amount FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY u.region ORDER BY median_order_amount DESC

question: 本月与上月订单数的环比增长率
sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)) SELECT ROUND((this_month.order_count - last_month.order_count)::numeric / NULLIF(last_month.order_count, 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM (SELECT order_count FROM monthly WHERE month = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)) this_month, (SELECT order_count FROM monthly WHERE month = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month') last_month

question: 各流量来源的转化率和访问量
sql: SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE converted = true) AS conversions, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE converted = true)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS conversion_rate_pct FROM traffic_sessions GROUP BY source ORDER BY conversion_rate_pct DESC

question: 查询客单价最高的10个客户
sql: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.email ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 10

question: 近30天每日广告花费趋势
sql: SELECT spend_date, SUM(amount) AS daily_spend FROM ad_spend WHERE spend_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY spend_date ORDER BY spend_date

question: 按注册渠道统计客户数量和总消费
sql: SELECT u.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS customer_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_revenue FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id AND o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY u.channel ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

question: 退款订单数量和退款率
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'refunded') AS refunded_count, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'refunded')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM orders

question: 各品类商品的销售数量排名
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_quantity DESC

question: Facebook广告活动的点击率和平均每次点击成本
sql: SELECT ac.name, SUM(as2.clicks) AS total_clicks, SUM(as2.impressions) AS total_impressions, ROUND(SUM(as2.clicks)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(as2.impressions), 0) * 100, 2) AS ctr_pct, ROUND(SUM(as2.amount) / NULLIF(SUM(as2.clicks), 0), 2) AS cpc FROM ad_spend as2 JOIN ad_campaigns ac ON ac.id = as2.campaign_id WHERE ac.platform = 'facebook' GROUP BY ac.name

question: 近7天每日新增订单和新增客户数
sql: SELECT d.day, COALESCE(o.new_orders, 0) AS new_orders, COALESCE(u.new_users, 0) AS new_users FROM (SELECT generate_series(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days', CURRENT_DATE, '1 day'::interval)::date AS day) d LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS new_orders FROM orders GROUP BY DATE(created_at)) o ON o.day = d.day LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE(registered_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM users GROUP BY DATE(registered_at)) u ON u.day = d.day ORDER BY d.day
